control_spec.budget: equal 120s simulated horizon and actuator bounds; actual energy is measured, not forced equal

learner.algorithm: linear Expected SARSA with accumulating eligibility traces, fixed-duration options and bounded recent one-step replay
learner.exploration: seeded shuffled first visit to each option, then epsilon-greedy max(.12,.4*exp(-decision_count/150)) with seeded tie handling
learner.failure_policy: strict act/observe cadence; reject stale/invalid/malformed observations, all motor/native flags and inconsistent reward sums without partial learner mutation

feature_encoder.12-14: log1p(lux)/log1p(1000), sensor-valid mask, fresh-light slope times4
feature_encoder.15-20: gyro and specific-force changes over at least.2s divided by40/s and100/s
feature_encoder.21-24: previous effort/.15, gyro magnitude/10, shaft acceleration/40, light age/.5
feature_encoder.25-27: .4s means of total reward rate/2, effort/.15 and shaft velocity/6
feature_encoder.28-31: encoder sin/cos, light level and light slope multiplied by shaft-speed feature
feature_encoder.3-5: signed/absolute shaft speed divided by6, current divided by2.5
feature_encoder.32-55: eight circular encoder radial bases times three coarse local shaft-speed bases
feature_encoder.6-11: three local specific-force axes divided by39.24 and gyro axes divided by10
feature_encoder.normalization: signed features clipped to[-1,1]; light level and age clipped to[0,1]; IDs never become features

learner.governor: same prospective local-shaft envelope as bounded rhythm probes; soft target is not a guaranteed physical speed limit
learner.memory: reset clears values/traces/history/replay; ordinary sensory changes retain and update them without a privileged change cue
learner.objective: discounted time-integrated SUM of exactly the attached sensor reward components; no lux-delta surrogate, target angle, pose or hidden motion score
learner.random_generator: splitmix64; separate deterministic action and replay streams
learner.replay_sampling: uniform over the most recent32 completed options
learner.scope: small exposed-development learner, not a convergence, optimality, topology-transfer or hardware claim

value_initialization.limitations: a finite initial value estimate, not a reward target, policy guarantee or privileged body/light cue
value_initialization.method: equal bias for all actions from measured quiet reward; all other parameters and traces start zero
value_initialization.purpose: give all actions the same measured background value before evidence distinguishes them

exposure: Known development bodies, seeds and light schedule; no frozen-v3 challenge exposure

physics_spec.contacts: disabled in this isolated planar fixture; no self-collision or ground
physics_spec.exposure: development-only construction; no old world, policy artifact, or heldout set

imu.axes: mounted segment local frame; no world orientation observation
imu.latency_rule: round nominal delivery up to the next .002s physics tick

light.coincident_source: zero illuminance when distance <= 1e-9m because incident direction is undefined
light.face_axis: mounted segment local +/-Z; optical site is on the corresponding cube face
light.noise_and_occlusion: none; the mounted hemisphere and distance are modeled, shadows are not

physics_spec.motion_plane: XZ; anchored at origin; hinges about +Y; initially hanging toward -Z
physics_spec.motor_feedback_timing: synchronous local servo feedback at the step endpoint
physics_spec.power_supply: fixed nominal catalog bus voltage; energy recorded, battery depletion not modeled
physics_spec.reward: mounted IMU plus light each vote once using unchanged catalog rewards and missing_reward; sum integrated every .002s

safety.imu: new construction_v1 supplemental veto: delivered sample reaches the catalog reward's hard acceleration-deviation or angular-speed threshold
safety.imu_threshold_scope: construction fixture only; no old world safety rule is changed
safety.motor: existing current, voltage, thermal and speed model; all flags retained
safety.numerical: MuJoCo numerical warnings, non-finite state or a simulator time reset fail closed
safety.veto_behavior: physical veto: zero powered torque, finish current .02s interval, require reset; numerical failure: abort immediately and require reset

sun.move_semantics: no reset; already acquired samples retain their original value
sun.reset_semantics: keep selected sun; reset physical state and acquisition queues
